MSV000085995.note: Laser-isolated human trophoblast subtypes. The description discusses both transcriptional and protein measurements; the deposited assay should be distinguished from the broader paper. No publication is listed on this MassIVE page.

fields.quote: Using mass spectrometry, discovery of differentially expressed mRNAs was extended to the protein level.

MSV000095456.note: Human placental imaging with lipidomic, metabolomic, and proteomic measurements. One full-term placenta is explicitly described; tissue regions and repeated measurements are not additional donors.

fields.quote: we utilized a full-term placenta from an obese person

Lipidomic and metabolomic imaging by MALDI-MSI visualized molecular composition and dynamic activities across the tissue sections, mapping placental villous regions with enriched metabolic activity related to sterol lipids and fatty acid processing. Our complementary proteome profiling of mapped regions allowed us to capture region-specific enzymes.

MSV000094962.note: Includes matched maternal plasma and placental villous tissue. The source says n=4 each group; the pilot preserves that statement without treating file counts or an inferred group total as placenta sample size.

fields.quote: Lipids were extracted and fatty acid composition of different lipid classes were analyzed by LC-MS/MS

phs001782.v2.p1.note: Placenta, cord tissue, and parental saliva occur in the study. Description reports 111 biopsies from 59 placentas for one dataset and 262 samples from 251 placentas for another. Keep those counts separate; donor overlap is not established. Total subjects is 802.

fields.value: Whole-transcriptome dataset: 59 placentas (111 biopsies); targeted RNA-seq dataset: 251 placentas (262 samples). Overlap between datasets is not stated.
fields.quote: The first dataset is the whole transcriptome RNA-Seq dataset of 111 biopsies (59 placentas) and genotyping of 96 genes. Birth length, weight, and placental weight for the children associated with this dataset are listed in the phenotype file (DOI: 10.1093/molbev/msz226). The second dataset includes targeted RNA-Seq of 262 samples (251 placentas) and targeted DNA-Seq for 766 genes.
